title: The Deep Ghost
premise: Jude Voss, a deniable fixer for the Meridian Section — an embassy that exists on no map — is confronted by a woman named Ilse who claims he saved her life in Prague fifteen years ago. He has no memory of it, but her proof is flawless and her demand simple: help her extract a defector carrying a memory-wipe protocol stolen from Meridian itself, or she exposes the operation that erased his own past. As Jude follows the trail through Vienna, Trieste, and the flooded archives beneath the old consulate, he discovers the 'favor' was manufactured to activate him as an unwitting courier of the very secret worth killing for. In the end, Jude chooses found loyalty over recovered identity: he burns the protocol, gives Ilse the escape route meant for him, and walks out with no name at all — finally free because there is nothing left to trade.
about_author: Dominic Eriksen is the pen name of a former logistics contractor who spent a decade shuttling between diplomatic annexes in Central Europe before turning to fiction. He writes thrillers about people whose paperwork matters more than their names, from a farmhouse outside Ljubljana.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Jude Voss, mid-routine cleanup of a diplomat's indiscretion in Vienna, is approached by Ilse Brandt, who repays a debt he doesn't remember incurring — with a key to a locker and a warning that interest is owed. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: unease; the first crack in a life built on rules.

chapters.title: Locker 44
chapters.summary: The locker holds a photograph of Jude in Prague, dated the year of his supposed recruitment, plus a partial dossier on something called the Lethe Protocol. His handler, Marsh, denies everything too quickly. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: vertigo — the ground floor of his identity gives way.

chapters.title: Rules, Rewritten
chapters.summary: Jude runs the photo through unofficial channels and learns Meridian scrubbed three days from his file. Marsh assigns him to hunt the defector who stole Lethe — knowing full well who Ilse is. POV: Jude, with a cold interlude from Marsh's perspective. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Woman from Prague
chapters.summary: Jude confronts Ilse instead of arresting her. She tells him what he did in Prague — pulled her out of a black-site transfer — and that Meridian wiped him to make him loyal. They form a wary pact. POV: alternating Jude and Ilse. Emotional beat: two strangers deciding to trust.

chapters.title: Trieste, Rising Water
chapters.summary: The pair trace the defector, Dr. Ansel Roth, to Trieste, where a Meridian wet team arrives ahead of them. A rooftop chase ends with Jude saving Ilse exactly as he once saved her — and this time he remembers choosing it. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: found family crystallizing under fire.

chapters.title: What Lethe Costs
chapters.summary: Roth explains the protocol: targeted memory erasure disguised as medical treatment, already deployed on four operatives — including, he believes, Jude. Marsh's team closes in; Roth is taken. POV: Roth's interrogation interlude, then Jude. Emotional beat: grief and guilt over a self he can't mourn properly.

chapters.title: The Flooded Archive
chapters.summary: Beneath the old consulate, in archives scheduled for flooding, Jude finds his own original file — and learns the Prague rescue was real, but so was his volunteering for the wipe. He wasn't only a victim; he was hiding from something he'd done. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: devastating ambiguity about who he truly is.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Marsh offers Jude restoration of his memories in exchange for Ilse and Roth's copy of Lethe. Jude stalls, plays both sides, and discovers Marsh intends to deploy Lethe domestically. The trade becomes a trap either way. POV: Jude and Marsh. Emotional beat: cornered clarity — he knows which side he's on now.

chapters.title: The Exchange
chapters.summary: At the arranged handover in a disused canal terminal, Jude springs his counter-trap: he's already copied and seeded Lethe's destruction across Meridian's own servers. The wet team turns on Marsh when Jude broadcasts proof of domestic deployment. Gunfire, floodwater, and Marsh's fall. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: climax — fury transmuted into sacrifice.

chapters.title: No Name at All
chapters.summary: With Lethe burned and Meridian quietly dissolved upward into plausible denial, Jude gives Ilse his extraction route and keeps the flooded archive's last truth to himself. He declines a new identity, walking out with nothing — and chooses her offer of coffee in a city where nobody knows him. POV: Jude. Emotional beat: resolution — freedom found not in recovering the past, but in releasing it.
